description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space. 
 
 
 All roles require onsite presence a minimum of four days per week. Some roles may require five days onsite based on role responsibilities, business needs and manager discretion. Schedule flexibility may be available depending on the role and manager approval, including a 9/80 work schedule and compensatory time off (time off earned for hours worked beyond 40 per week) for eligible employees.


 Building on The Aerospace Corporation's reputation as a trusted, impartial advisor with integrity and dedication to mission success, the Civil Systems Group (CSG) combines deep technical expertise with market-leading innovation to help our customers solve complex systems engineering and integration challenges. CSG is organized by core customer-facing lines of business to manage and grow programs within NASA, NOAA, and the NNSA, while extending our capabilities to other civilian federal government agencies fully integrated within Aerospace rules, regulations, processes, values, and behaviors.
  
 Within the CSG, the NASA Programs Division (NPD) supports our NASA customer in all aspects of human space flight. We are looking for a Moon Base Application Developer (Project Engineer- Systems Software Engineering and Cloud Computing Architecture) The primary function of this position is to provide custom application development efforts for the NASA Moon Base Program. As the developer representing Aerospace on this NASA team, you’ll be instrumental in leveraging AWS cloud technology to enhance collaboration, streamline workflows, and facilitate knowledge management for critical space exploration initiatives within Moon Base.  
   
 The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in Houston, TX/Johnson Space Center or Huntsville, AL/Marshall Space Flight Center offering a Hybrid work model that requires 3-4 regular onsite workdays and remote flexibility as the business needs allow.  
   
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 Developing both front-end and back-end components of web applications using Node.js, web frameworks (e.g. Express JS), and front-end frameworks. 
 Design and manage database schemas and interactions for relation (MySQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB) databases.
 Containerize applications using Docker to ensure consistent behavior across environments.
 Contributing to AI integration within the Moon Base cloud platform
 Implement security measures and access controls to safeguard sensitive information and ensure compliance with NASA's cybersecurity policies, data protection regulations, and industry best practices. 
 Educating end users on availability, capability, and operation of tools
 Effectively and respectfully communicating with managers and researchers across different disciplines and multiple contracts regarding application, data, and reporting needs. 
   
 What You Need to be Successful- Project Engineer- Systems Software Engineering and Cloud Computing Architecture 
 Minimum Requirements for: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or another related STEM discipline  
 Minimum 6 years of experience with web application development. 
 Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js frameworks 
 Familiarity with version control software (e.g. Git), front-end web development languages (eg. HTML, CSS, JavaScript), and cloud platforms (AWS) and cloud-managed services (e.g. S3, RDS, Lambda).
 Superior analytical, planning, problem solving, and decision-making skills 
 Excellent written and oral communication skills including effectively explaining concepts to managers and end users  
 Ability to work effectively in a multi-disciplinary setting and manage multiple concurrent tasks and provide direction on competing priorities 
 Willing to travel [domestically] approx. [10%] 
 This position may require the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance. 
   
 How You Can Stand Out 
 It would be impressive if you have one or more of these: 
 Master’s degree in Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or another related STEM discipline 
 8 or more years of increasingly responsible professional engineering experience including experience in a systems engineering and/or program management environment
 Experience with NASA or commercial human space flight programs 
 Knowledge of NASA system engineering practices 
 Understanding of NASA's Moon Base Program goals and objectives 
 Experience adapting to evolving technologies and emerging trends in web and cloud application development 
 Extensive experience with data integration, reporting, and data visualization tools 
 Demonstrated experience with collaborations supporting multiple research disciplines/specialties 
 
 
 We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business.  The grade-based pay range for this job is listed below.  Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills. 
 
 (Min - Max)
$131,400.00 - $197,000.00 
 
Pay Basis: Annual 
 Leadership Competencies 
 Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who: 
 Operate Strategically 
 Lead Change    
 Engage with Impact    
 Foster Innovation    
 Deliver Results   
 
 Ways We Reward Our Employees 
 During your interview process, our team will provide details of our industry-leading benefits.
 Benefits vary and are applicable based on Job Type.  A few highlights include: 
 Comprehensive health care and wellness plans

 Paid holidays, sick time, and vacation

 Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options

 401(k) Plan — Employees receive a total company-paid benefit of 8%, 10%, or 12% of eligible compensation based on years of service and matching contributions; employees are immediately eligible and vested in the plan upon hire

 Flexible spending accounts

 Variable pay program for exceptional contributions

 Relocation assistance

 Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career

 Education assistance programs

 An inclusive work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect

 
 We are all unique, from various backgrounds and all walks of life, yet one thing bonds all of us to each other—the belief that we can make a difference. This core belief empowers us to do our best work at The Aerospace Corporation.
 
 
 Equal Opportunity Commitment 
 The Aerospace Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, color, religion, genetic information, marital status, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, physical disability, medical condition, mental disability, or disability status and any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. If you’re an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran who needs assistance using our online job search and application tools or need reasonable accommodation to complete the job application process, please contact us by phone at 310.336.5432 or by email at  peoplemangmnt.mailbox@aero.org . You can also review  Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal .
